import sys,random,itertools
sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/submission')
from netnomos.finite import _WorldGeometry
rng=random.Random(9)
vals=[0,1,2,9,10,11,99,100,101,999,1000,9999,10000,99999,100000,999999,1000000]
for it in range(2000):
 m=rng.randint(1,4)
 doms=[]
 for i in range(m):
  pool=vals+rng.sample(range(1000001),rng.randint(0,10))
  doms.append(tuple(sorted(set(rng.sample(pool,rng.randint(1,8))))))
 U=1
 for d in doms:U*=len(d)
 if U>2000:continue
 worlds=list(itertools.product(*doms));g=_WorldGeometry(doms)
 # all query positions, many prefixes
 for pos in range(m):
  prefixes=['','0','00','0000000','0000001']
  for _ in range(20):
   prefixes.append(''.join(str(rng.randrange(10)) for _ in range(rng.randint(1,7))))
  for p in prefixes:
   want=0
   for i,w in enumerate(worlds):
    if str(w[pos]).startswith(p):want|=1<<i
   got=g.prefix_mask(pos,p)
   if want!=got:
    print('FAIL pref',doms,pos,p,bin(want),bin(got));raise SystemExit
   wante=sum(1<<i for i,w in enumerate(worlds) if str(w[pos])==p)
   got=g.exact_spelling_mask(pos,p)
   if wante!=got:
    print('FAIL exact',doms,pos,p,wante,got);raise SystemExit
 # fixed all values
 for pos in range(m):
  for v in doms[pos]:
   want=sum(1<<i for i,w in enumerate(worlds) if w[pos]==v)
   assert g.value_mask(pos,v)==want
print('large value prefix tests pass')
